title: tensor quotient epimorphism
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, small in a universe containing the coefficients [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $q:R'\to R$ be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings that is locally surjective: every section of $R$ lifts to $R'$ after a covering of its domain. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $R'$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Form the sheaf tensor product $R\otimes_{R'}F$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and regard it as an $R'$-module via $q$. Then the canonical $R'$-linear map
$$F\longrightarrow R\otimes_{R'}F,\qquad m\longmapsto1\otimes m,$$
is locally surjective and is an epimorphism of sheaves of $R'$-modules.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(1), omitted proof: local elementary tensors lift through the coefficient quotient
